title: Necessary radius for weighted contraction
statement: Let $p,\lambda,\rho\in\bbr$ satisfy $1<p<2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $\rho\ge0$. Suppose that for every $u,v\in\bbr$, $(\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v)^2+\rho^2\lambda(1-\lambda)(u-v)^2\le\big(\lambda|u|^p+(1-\lambda)|v|^p\big)^{2/p}$. Then $\rho\le\rho(p/(p-1),\lambda)$, the sharp discrete hypercontractive radius at parameters $p/(p-1)$ and $\lambda$.
hypotheses_covered: The stated inequality holds for every real $u,v$
replaced: Let $1<p<2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $\rho\ge0$. If $(\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v)^2+\rho^2\lambda(1-\lambda)(u-v)^2\le(\lambda|u|^p+(1-\lambda)|v|^p)^{2/p}$ for every $u,v\in\bbr$, then $\rho\le\rho_*(p/(p-1),\lambda)$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
